Suriya's next film to be produced by KGF makers, directed by TJ Gnanavel

Actor Suriya's upcoming film, tentatively titled 'Suriya 48', will be produced by Hombale Films, the production house behind the 'KGF' series. The film will be directed by TJ Gnanavel, who previously worked with Suriya on the critically acclaimed 'Jai Bhim'. This collaboration marks a significant project for the South Indian film industry.
